why: Found by I119 while building (b), after its prereg (1c3770b8) and with its audit running; I119-P8 predicted it (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). Without ops typed, P2's reasoner control asserts that the Go frontend prunes IncWrap's wrapped branch b[2]+1 < b[2]. That is the unbounded reading I117 reported as unsound (Surprise 1). HUMAN_ANSWERS Q93 (1)(b) makes the opaque-arithmetic rule the default for every Go document, so that reading no longer exists. The amended control states the mode the assertion was written for. Before I119, the branch was pruned without ops typed (recorded by I119's audit on its own fixture, results/M6/I119/audit.json fixture.old). From I119 on, the branch is kept with or without ops typed. Every other assertion is unchanged: no typed section without ops typed, and no paths for Bump. So the claim (ops typed keeps the wrapped branch) is unchanged.

Amended by I118 under the lead's rule (run every earlier tests-m6 job after a lead merge, and amend a regression that globs later protocols, line first), as I112, I115 and I116 did. The test globs every spec/*/lib/*.json and refuses any protocol naming go.ops other than i117_run.json, so a later key's protocol that carries I117's landed opt-in by construction (I118's spec/M6/lib/i118_run.json, which lists it in i117_keys) fails it. It now skips the protocols of iteration I117 and later, the mode it was written for: no earlier protocol names go.ops. The assertion is unchanged.

Found by I120 while writing its prereg, before any build commit or measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P6 says that without the opt-ins every output is as before, so no protocol earlier than I117's names go.ops. It globbed every spec/*/lib/*.json except i117_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I120's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i120_run.json, I117's plus go.store_scope) carries I117's go.ops by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I117 and later keys (an iteration number of 117 or more, read from the protocol's own iteration field), as I115 and I112 amended their own P6 checks. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the assertion is unchanged.
